description: Bun.serve, Bun's own HTTP server, with no framework on top and one process per core sharing the ports. The same routes serve every protocol: HTTP/1.1 on 8080 and over TLS on 8081, h2c on 8082 and h2 plus HTTP/3 on 8443 through Bun's experimental `http2: true` and `http3: true` flags (QUIC is Bun's own lsquic, no proxy in front).
